title: Knowledge entry frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a knowledge entry kept in the repo (docs/contracts/knowledge.md): its title and provenance. Every field is optional so existing documents index as they are; keys of other tools are allowed and ignored. A file without author_role, source and created gets its provenance from git. Entries forecrewd writes always carry all of them.

title.description: Entry title; default the first # heading, else the file name.

author_role.description: Role that wrote the entry, or human.

source.description: Where it comes from: a ref (JOB-41, GOAL-3, KB-5, DEC-2), a URL, or human.

created.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or RFC 3339 time it was first written.

last_verified.description: Date or time it was last checked against the code.
